URBAN DEVELOMENT AUTHORITY LAW No. 41 OF 1978
Order under Section 3

I, Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development by virtue of the powers vested in meunder Section 3 of the Urban Development Authority Law No. 41 of 1978, do hereby declare the area set out in Column I &Column II under the Schedule I hereto, having the metes and bounds specified in corresponding entry in Column II ofSchedule as the “Port City Colombo” Urban Development Area, for the purpose of the said Section.

PATALI CHAMPIKA RANAWAKA (MP),Minister of Megapolis and Western Development.Ministry of Megapolis and Western Development,17th and 18th Floors,“Suhurupaya”,Sri Subhuthipura Road,Battaramulla,20th August, 2019.
This Gazette Extraordinary can be downloaded from www.documents.gov.lk1A - G 30790— 37 (08/2019)

All that allotement of land marked as Lot Nos. 2 to 7 andhaving the metes and bounds specified in Column II, knownas the “Port City Colombo” depicted in TracingNo. CO/DSO/2019/370 dated 11.06.2019 prepared by theSurveyor General containing in extent of 446.6153 ha.situated in Colombo, in the Western Province at thefollowing connection points.

DECLARATION OF “PORT CITY COLOMBO” URBAN DEVELOPMENT AREA
The total area covered from following boundaries.
North :A line drawn Easterwards along the Southern Boundary ofLot No. 01 from the meeting point of Northern Boundry ofLot No. 07 and the Southern Boundary of Lot No. 01

South :From the end point of above Eastern Boundary of Lot No. 07,a line drawn along the Southern Boundary of the Lot No. 07until the end of Southern Boundary.
East :From the end point of above Southern Boundary of Lot No.07, a line drawn along the Western Boundary of Lot No. 07until it meets starting point.
